commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot to Proton and add greeting
implement mark as done without using additional class
Add unmark command without using additional classes
Refactor task data into a dedicated Task class

commitResults.messageBody:
The Java classes use the default package and leave parts of their public
API undocumented. Fixed values are also represented as mutable local
variables, including a misspelled separator name.

Move both classes into the proton package and document their public
APIs. Promote fixed values to named constants. This aligns the code with
the required se-edu conventions without changing chatbot behavior.

Terminal diffs are hard to navigate for large or multi-file changes.

Add a repository-scoped skill that generates a self-contained split-view
HTML comparison for commits and worktree changes. This gives reviewers
an interactive view without adding dependencies to the Java application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add se-edu Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java contributions need a consistent project-wide style reference.

Add a repository-scoped skill summarizing the se-edu basic and
intermediate Java conventions. Mandate it in AGENTS.md so future Java
changes are reviewed and validated against the same rules.

Commit messages need consistent structure and rationale.

Add a repository-scoped skill covering the se-edu commit and branch
conventions. Mandate it in AGENTS.md while preserving the existing
lightweight-tag and commit authorization rules.

Add the project-specific test-ui skill and initial UI test plan.

Compare exact outputs, stop on failure, and retain session transcripts.

Require agents to invoke the skill after every code change.
